recognize_zh: 真皮 H&E 中倍下彌漫的大型非典型細胞，細胞質豐富嗜酸性、核大而多形、可見核仁，並夾雜許多嗜中性球、嗜酸性球與小淋巴球，在皮膚病灶脈絡中符合原發性皮膚退行性大細胞淋巴瘤（CD30+）。
features: Diffuse dermal infiltrate of large atypical cells with abundant eosinophilic to amphophilic cytoplasm
Large pleomorphic, oval to kidney-shaped vesicular nuclei with visible nucleoli
Occasional multinucleated or horseshoe-like nuclei suggestive of hallmark cells
Mixed inflammatory background of neutrophils, eosinophils, and small lymphocytes
Loose edematous stroma with collagen bundles and extravasated RBCs
describe_en: Skin biopsy shows a diffuse dermal infiltrate of large atypical cells with abundant eosinophilic to amphophilic cytoplasm and large pleomorphic vesicular nuclei with conspicuous nucleoli; some nuclei are kidney-shaped or multilobated. The large cells are admixed with numerous neutrophils, eosinophils, and small lymphocytes in an edematous stroma. Epidermis is not included in this field. Findings are consistent with a CD30-positive large cell lymphoproliferative disorder, supporting primary cutaneous anaplastic large cell lymphoma when CD30 is expressed by more than 75% of large cells and systemic ALCL is excluded clinically and by ALK staining.

ddx.dx: Lymphomatoid papulosis, type A or C
ddx.vs: LyP shares identical cytology; it is distinguished clinically by recurrent self-healing papules under 2 cm, whereas pcALCL forms larger persistent nodules or tumors.

ddx.dx: Systemic ALK-positive ALCL with skin involvement
ddx.vs: Systemic ALCL is typically ALK-positive with nodal disease, while primary cutaneous ALCL is ALK-negative and confined to skin at staging.

ddx.dx: Mycosis fungoides with large cell transformation
ddx.vs: Transformed MF arises in a patient with prior patches/plaques and epidermotropic small cerebriform cells, with variable CD30 expression.
Carcinoma is keratin-positive and melanoma is S100/SOX10-positive, whereas ALCL cells are CD30-positive and CD45 or T-cell antigen positive.
